meta_description: Demon Sprays Ltd, Nottingham painter and decorator. Interior and exterior painting, spray finishing, and decorating services. Get a free quote today.
hero_subhead: Transform your home or business with expert interior and exterior painting across Nottingham and Long Eaton.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services in Nottingham
services_subhead: From interior redecoration to full exterior repaints, we handle residential and commercial projects with care and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh your living spaces with our interior painting service. We prepare surfaces properly, use quality emulsions and eggshell finishes, and transform rooms on time and on budget.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and enhance your property's exterior. We specialise in weatherproof coatings, masonry paint, and timber treatment that withstand Nottinghamshire's climate for years to come.

services.title: Spray Finishing & Application
services.desc: Achieve a professional, flawless finish with spray application. Perfect for doors, furniture, kitchens, and large surfaces where a smooth, even coat makes all the difference.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: We work around your business schedule. From offices and retail spaces to care homes and schools, we deliver fast, efficient decoration with minimal disruption.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Expert wallpaper installation and removal. We measure, match, and hang patterns perfectly, and can strip old paper cleanly without damaging your walls.

services.title: Surface Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: We don't cut corners on prep work. Proper sanding, patching, and priming ensure your paint lasts longer and looks sharper, inside and out.

about_pullquote: We take pride in leaving every home cleaner than we found it.
about_para_1: Demon Sprays Ltd has been transforming homes and businesses across Nottinghamshire for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that painting done right takes time and care, we've built our reputation on attention to detail and professional workmanship. Every project, from a single room refresh to a full commercial repaint, is treated with the same commitment to quality.
about_para_2: Our customers choose us because we listen, we turn up on time, and we finish what we start. We use quality materials, prepare surfaces properly, and always protect your furniture and floors. Word-of-mouth and repeat bookings are the lifeblood of our business—that tells you everything you need to know about how we work.
reviews_heading: What Nottinghamshire Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Excellent job on our kitchen diner. Mark and the lads arrived bang on time, worked tidily, and the finish is absolutely perfect. Very reasonable price too. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Had our whole house exterior painted. The prep work was thorough and the lads were professional throughout. Looks brand new. Very happy with the result and the aftercare advice.
reviews.author: Caroline M.

reviews.text: Called Demon Sprays to redecorate our lounge and hall. Quoted fairly, turned up when they said they would, and finished two days earlier than expected. Great attention to detail. Will be ringing them for the bedrooms next.
reviews.author: Robert T.
